justification: New table + build script + 2 API endpoints + frontend proxy. No existing data modified. Build script writes to new table only. API reads only. Standard tier: new feature, multiple files, no existing data mutation.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads nsw_cadastre_lots (3.2M rows), spatial_overlays (1.1M rows), dcp_setback_controls (1K), housing_sepp_standards (45). Writes to NEW lot_search_index table only.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If spatial_overlays has no zone data for an LGA, that LGA is skipped (get_lga_list only returns LGAs with zone overlays). If DCP controls missing, CA columns stay NULL — graceful degradation.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New table — INSERT only. ON CONFLICT upsert for re-runs.

functions.name: assign_overlays_for_lga
functions.output: Rows written to lot_search_index with overlay columns populated
functions.if_none: Returns 0 lots processed, no writes if lga_name matches zero lots

functions.name: compute_constraints_for_lga
functions.output: Updates CA columns in lot_search_index for lots with zone+area data
functions.if_none: Returns 0 if no pending lots, DCP/SEPP cache returns [] for unknown zones

functions.name: _build_where
functions.output: Parameterised SQL WHERE clause string + params list
functions.if_none: Returns 'TRUE' with empty params — no filter applied

functions.name: lot_search
functions.output: LotSearchResponse with paginated lots, total_count, query_ms
functions.if_none: Returns 200 with empty lots list and total_count=0

functions.name: lot_search_summary
functions.input: LotSearchRequest POST body (same filters as lot_search)
functions.if_none: Returns 200 with total_lots=0 and None for numeric aggregates

values.if_missing: Returned as null in JSON response

values.nullable: yes — COALESCE(planlotarea, shape_area) could be NULL if both NULL
values.guard_at: scripts/build_lot_search_index.py:260 — WHERE lot_area_m2 > 0 filters NULLs from CA compute
values.if_missing: Lot inserted with NULL area, excluded from CA compute, CA columns stay NULL

queries.purpose: Insert base lot data via spatial join with zone overlays
queries.where_clause: so.layer_type = 'zone' AND so.lga_name = %s AND c.geom IS NOT NULL
queries.if_zero: No rows inserted — LGA has no zone overlays, function returns 0
queries.if_wrong: Lots from adjacent LGAs could match if zone overlay geometries overlap LGA boundaries — mitigated by DISTINCT ON (lotidstring)

queries.where_clause: Dynamic — built from _build_where() with parameterised %s placeholders
queries.if_zero: Returns empty lots list with total_count=0
queries.if_wrong: SQL injection prevented by parameterised queries + order_by whitelist

queries.where_clause: lga_name = %s AND zone_code IS NOT NULL AND lot_area_m2 > 0 AND ca_realistic_gfa_m2 IS NULL
queries.if_wrong: Lots without zone data excluded (correct — CA needs zone for SEPP lookup)

break_it.what_happens: Attacker passes 'DROP TABLE users; --' as order_by
break_it.how: services/lot_search.py:187 — order_by checked against _ALLOWED_ORDER_COLS whitelist; invalid values fall back to default. order_dir validated by Pydantic regex pattern.
break_it.repro: POST /lot-search {"order_by": "DROP TABLE users; --"} → falls back to ca_realistic_gfa_m2

break_it.scenario: Lot assigned to wrong LGA when zone overlays from adjacent LGAs overlap
break_it.what_happens: Lot appears in multiple LGAs' results or gets wrong LGA assignment
break_it.how: scripts/build_lot_search_index.py:98 — ON CONFLICT (lotidstring) DO UPDATE overwrites with latest LGA processed. Lot has exactly one row in the index.
break_it.repro: Run overlays for two adjacent LGAs, check lots near boundary

break_it.scenario: DB size exceeds 8GB Supabase limit when indexing all LGAs with geometry
break_it.how: Risk flagged in plan — check DB size after Inner West pilot before statewide run. Option: drop geom column from index.

break_it.scenario: Parameterised lot search returns stale data after overlay re-ingest
break_it.what_happens: Lot search returns outdated zone/height/FSR values until build script re-runs
break_it.how: scripts/build_lot_search_index.py — ON CONFLICT upsert overwrites on re-run. computed_at timestamp tracks staleness. Incremental refresh function available.
break_it.repro: Re-ingest overlays for LGA, query /lot-search before re-running build script — values reflect previous ingest

break_it.scenario: Lots pending CA compute never get computed if zone_code is NULL
break_it.what_happens: Lots without zone assignment (step 2 failed) are silently excluded from CA compute
break_it.how: scripts/build_lot_search_index.py:351 — WHERE zone_code IS NOT NULL is intentional. Without zone, SEPP lookup is impossible. These lots get overlay data only, CA columns stay NULL, ca_confidence stays NULL.
break_it.repro: Insert lot into lot_search_index with NULL zone_code, run compute phase — lot skipped

post_merge.db_reset: No — new table only, run migration 010 on Supabase
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — run migration, then build script for Inner West as pilot
